item.title: Alberta RCMP receive more reports of people with weapons after Tumbler Ridge shooting
item.description: EDMONTON — Mounties in Alberta say there's been an uptick in calls for people with a weapon and school lockdowns since the mass school shooting in Tumbler Ridge.

item.title: Beijing drops visa requirement for Canadian tourists, business visitors to China
item.description: OTTAWA — China is dropping its visa requirement for Canadian tourists and business visitors, a move that has boosted the spirits of Vancouver travel agents following Prime Minister Mark Carney's efforts to put relations with Beijing on a better footi

item.title: Hundreds of thousands march in Toronto rally in support of Iran protests
item.description: TORONTO — Hundreds of thousands of people marched down Yonge Street to the beat of drums and chants of “King Reza Pahlavi” at a rally Saturday in North York, as similar protests took place in major cities around the world.

item.title: KNOWLES, Joan
item.description: Mrs. Joan Knowles passed away peacefully at Hospice Wellington on Feb. 5, 2026, at the age of 86. Beloved wife of the late Alan Knowles (2021). Joan was predeceased by their son Andrew Alan (1976) and her parents, Stanley and Rose Mills.

item.title: Quebec Liberal Party welcomes new leader Charles Milliard
item.description: TROIS-RIVIÈRES — About 600 people welcomed Charles Milliard as the new head of the Quebec Liberal Party in Trois-Rivières on Sunday, days after he was acclaimed in a leadership race that no one else joined.

item.title: How a day of chaos and heartache unspooled in Tumbler Ridge
item.description: Nothing is too far apart in tiny Tumbler Ridge, B.C., and there was a well-worn path between the local RCMP detachment and the nondescript brown timber home on Fellers Avenue, less than a kilometre away.

item.title: VIDEO: One year ago, this Ontario man vanished from a Quebec ski resort
item.description: 'Somebody out there does know something': The search continues for 22-year-old Liam Toman, who suddenly disappeared last winter during a ski trip with friends at Mont-Tremblant

item.title: Misinformation experts warn of dire consequences in online hunt for blame
item.description: Disinformation experts say while it's human nature to seek out more information after a tragedy, an online rush to identify suspects can have terrible consequences.

item.title: Carney strategy for defence industry pledges 125,000 jobs, sweeping policy changes
item.description: OTTAWA — The Liberal government is making sweeping changes to the way it approaches supporting the domestic defence industry, as Canada looks to transition away from overreliance on the United States for military gear.

item.title: Police tape down in Tumbler Ridge as shooting victim is honoured 14,000 km away
item.description: TUMBLER RIDGE — On a cold grey morning, residents of Tumbler Ridge, B.C., made their way to their churches' first Sunday services since the recent shootings in the tiny community in which nine people died.
